description: Source code for the mcumgr image management client implementation in Zephyr OS, handling image state, upload, and erase operations via SMP protocol.

methods.name: image_state_res_fn
methods.description: Handles response for image state read/write operations, decoding CBOR data to populate image info structure.

methods.name: image_upload_res_fn
methods.description: Handles response for image upload, decoding CBOR response to update upload offset and status.

methods.name: erase_res_fn
methods.description: Handles response for erase operation, decoding CBOR to determine success or failure.

methods.name: upload_message_header_size
methods.description: Calculates the size of the message header for image upload CBOR message.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_init
methods.description: Initializes an image management client with SMP client and image list parameters.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_upload_init
methods.description: Prepares the client for uploading an image, calculating header size.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_upload
methods.description: Performs image data upload in chunks, handling encoding, transmission, and response processing.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_state_write
methods.description: Sends a request to write or update image state, including hash and confirmation.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_state_read
methods.description: Requests current image state information from the device.

methods.name: img_mgmt_client_erase
methods.description: Requests erasure of a specified image slot.
